text: Update 2026-08-30 ~21:xx: the observe API now EXISTS on heft, but still only as an UNCOMMITTED working-tree change: /home/mark/crates/oscore is at fork main 7434512 with src/lib.rs locally modified (5 unprotect_observe matches; git pull refuses: unstaged changes). With it, lichen-node compiles and cargo test -p lichen-node runs (293/294, the 1 failure filed as the rfc6554 InvalidSourceRoute bead). The fork still needs the observe work committed+pushed for this to be durable - any git operation that resets the shared crate checkout will re-break every heft Rust build.
